messages:
alex: quick post-incident sync — heads up we saw token revocations not logged in the central audit stream. Need owners for backfill, validation, perms review, and secrets rotation. I sketched actions below.

maria: please drop the list here.

alex: list: 
- backfill missing revocation events into audit-store (72h window)
- run a validation sweep across refresh/session token codepaths
- review service RBAC rules for potential escalation edge-cases
- rotate affected ingress keys (staging then prod) with rollback plan
- add a recurring check for token-skew regressions in daily digest

maria: I'll take the audit backfill + verification. I'll open INF-472. ETA Thu EOD.

tim: I'll do the validation sweep and add the weekly alert rule. Running test harness now.

jordan: I'll own secrets rotation. Staging tomorrow morning, prod Friday early window. Will add playbook.

sec-bot: Created follow-ups: INF-472 (audit-backfill) -> maria, INF-473 (token-sweep) -> tim, INF-474 (secrets-rotation) -> jordan.

maria: question: do we want to replay events from kafka or pull from instance logs?

alex: replay from kafka is preferred for fidelity. Use `audit-replay --since 72h --topic=auth-events`. Add results to INF-472.

tim: harness output: ```
WARN authz: missing jti header on refresh token path
file: auth/validator.go:141
```

jordan: noted. I'll include a pre-rotate smoke test (token exchange + healthcheck) and rollback instructions. Tagging infra-oncall for prod window.

alex: two asks: 1) each ticket must have clear acceptance criteria (logs replayed, tests pass, rotation completed, smoke tests green); 2) Tim please add alert: threshold >3 token incidents in 7 days.

tim: will add acceptance criteria and alert to INF-473. Target finish: tomorrow.

maria: added acceptance criteria to INF-472 and started backfill.

jordan: rotation playbook and change freeze window added to INF-474. Prod rota scheduled and paging set.

alex: summary of owners/ETAs:
• INF-472 — maria — audit backfill + verification — ETA Thu EOD
• INF-473 — tim — token validation sweep + alert — ETA Wed EOD
• INF-474 — jordan — secrets rotation playbook + prod rotation Fri AM
React with :white_check_mark: when done. We'll reconvene in a week to review recurrence metrics.

maria: :white_check_mark:

tim: :white_check_mark: starting sweep now

jordan: :white_check_mark: rotation scheduled

alex: tagging @sec-oncall to oversee prod gating. If anything blocks, escalate to oncall.

sec-bot: Follow-up summary posted to #incidents-log with links to INF-472/INF-473/INF-474.
